message: I was rummaging through my closet the other day when I stumbled upon my old go-bag. It was packed to the brim with snacks, water, and even a few silly items like a deck of cards and a cozy blanket. My family always teases me for being the gloriously over-prepared person, but the truth is, it brings me comfort knowing I’m ready for whatever might come our way. 🌟 Sometimes, it’s the little things that make us feel secure, isn’t it?
